plugins.name: dnd-characters
plugins.description: MCP server for managing Dungeons & Dragons characters in Cloudflare D1. Use these tools to list, search, create, update, and delete characters. Each character has a name, class, species, level (1-20), and alignment. Characters are addressed by their 24-character hex character id; get an id from dnd_list_characters or dnd_search_characters before calling get/update/delete.

plugins.name: huit-search
plugins.description: MCP server for topic search over the Harvard University IT (HUIT) website, on Cloudflare Workers with Okta OAuth.

plugins.name: image-generator
plugins.description:
When using the generate_image tool, you MUST include the full image URL in your response to the user. The URL is the most important part of the response - without it, the user cannot view the generated image. Always format it as a clickable link.

When working with tool results, write down any important information you might need later in your response, as the original tool result may be cleared later.

plugins.name: selenography-lunar-features-server
plugins.description: MCP server for exploring lunar selenography data. Use these tools to search, filter, and analyze features on the Moon's surface including craters, maria, mountains, and more.
